source_snapshot.procedure: Install stress-ng or CPU vendor tool and stress both CPUs for 12 hours.

historical_reviews.related_cases: Other margin quadrants cannot define the expected cold/high-rail power behavior.

original_test_intent: Demonstrate stable 12-hour CPU0 and CPU1 operation at 0C and +5% 5V/3.3V rails, with approved maximum-power behavior and no compute, RAS or platform errors.
original_method: Map both sockets, cores, NUMA nodes and power/thermal sensors; define a socket-affined stress profile and the maximum-watt domain/statistic/target/tolerance; maintain chamber humidity/dew-point control, cold-soak and apply measured +5% rails; sustain both sockets for 12 hours while collecting load, frequency, power, thermal, throttle and RAS evidence; stop on limits, warm safely and restore nominal state.
manual_activity: Operator controls dry chamber/high rails, supervises both sockets and performs safe warm-up/restoration.
required_inputs: Stress tool/version/profile and per-socket load floor
Frequency, throttle, thermal and RAS limits
Heartbeat, OOB abort and warm-up/restoration plan
safety_requirements: Control humidity/dew point throughout cold transition
Use calibrated rail/power/thermal measurement and avoid overshoot
Maintain OOB access and do not erase logs
Abort on thermal, power, RAS, heartbeat or moisture limit
Warm above dew point before opening chamber
agent_execution_scope: May validate topology and analyze per-socket telemetry
Must not control chamber/rails or determine DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve workload, watt oracle and cold profile

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correct manual boundary; it does not define per-socket coverage or what 'max watts' means.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Operator runs the approved socket-affined profile after stable dry cold/high-rail conditions and power oracle are established.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: CPU0 and CPU1, 0C, +5% 5V/3.3V and 12 hours are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Correlate per-socket load/frequency/power/RAS with rail, chamber and dew-point telemetry for the entire run.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds socket attribution, interpretable max-watt criterion, condensation/overshoot protection, abort and warm-up.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Aggregate utilization or another temperature/rail quadrant cannot prove both sockets under this condition.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Cold operation may alter boost and power behavior; 'match max' is meaningless until the sensor domain and tolerance are approved.

project_override_considerations: Owner defines maximum-power semantics and acceptable cold/high-rail frequency/power limiting as well as stabilization dwell.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently requests dual-CPU cold/high-rail stress; the maximum-watt phrase is underspecified, not contradictory.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Purpose and method are clear; power oracle and safety limits remain engineering inputs before execution/verdict.

review_improvement: Makes both socket coverage and cold/high-rail maximum-power evidence measurable while protecting against condensation.
independent_technical_reasoning: A whole-host workload can leave one NUMA domain lightly loaded, and cold/high-rail conditions can change boost/power-limit behavior.
